name: Blur
description: A plain blur behind the window. The scene behind the surface is blurred and lightly tinted, and shows through wherever the window itself is translucent. Brightness, contrast, saturation, vibrancy and a fine grain shape the blurred scene. The bottom corners can be left square. The Content opacity parameter sets how much of the window content stays visible over the blur.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Blur radius
parameters.description: How strongly the scene behind the window is blurred (px). Past a display scale of 125% the top of the range stops adding blur, and the lowest setting is already a soft blur rather than none

parameters.name: Corner radius
parameters.description: Corner rounding of the blur slab (px, match the Border pack)

parameters.name: Content opacity
parameters.description: How visible the window content stays over the pane, where 1.0 is fully opaque and 0.0 shows only the blurred backdrop

parameters.name: Tint strength
parameters.description: How much of the tint colour is mixed over the blurred scene

parameters.name: Tint colour
parameters.description: Colour mixed over the blurred scene

parameters.name: Brightness
parameters.description: Gain on the blurred scene. 1.0 leaves it as captured

parameters.name: Contrast
parameters.description: Contrast of the blurred scene around mid grey. 1.0 leaves it as captured

parameters.name: Saturation
parameters.description: Colour saturation of the blurred scene. 0 is greyscale and 1.0 leaves it as captured

parameters.name: Noise
parameters.description: Fine grain over the blur that hides banding in smooth gradients

parameters.name: Round bottom corners
parameters.description: Round the bottom corners as well as the top. Turn off to round only the top two, for a pane that sits against a panel or the screen edge. The whole chain follows one answer, taken from the first pack that carries the setting, so the bottom corners are all rounded or all square.

parameters.name: Edge softness
parameters.description: Anti-alias feather of the pane edge, in device pixels, so it does not grow with display scaling. Lower is crisper.

parameters.name: Vibrancy
parameters.description: Boosts saturation where a colour is already saturated and bright, so muted scenes stay muted. 0 turns it off, and Vibrancy darkness widens it to darker colours

parameters.name: Vibrancy darkness
parameters.description: How far the vibrancy boost reaches into darker colours. Does nothing while Vibrancy is 0, which is where it starts
